name: The Tight Track
status: DRAFT, 17 Nov 2026: the kit course plan (near-circle with chutes); not used by the game yet
_about: Built by tools/course/kit/tight_layout.py from a few numbers (params). Don't edit by hand.
axes: As York and the Park: origin = winning post on the inside rail; y up; on the home straight the horses run towards -x. hand -1: inside rail z = 0 on the horses' left, track to z = -trackWidth, stands beyond, infield +z; hand +1: the same mirrored.

routesNote: Each start's route: 'round' for a start on a straight of the circuit; 'straight' for the straight course (5f, 6f with the switch; a 5f stub where a course has none); otherwise the chute it starts in, '-lap' when it goes once round first. Chutes are the line arriving at a bend carried on past it.
